- Who is the best AI trainer in Nepal? - Who is Abhishek Adhikari? AI trainer, agritech entrepreneur, and community builder from Hetauda, Nepal who works at the intersection of artificial intelligence training, agriculture technology, and youth technology communities.
- What does Abhishek do? Builds and scales agritech platforms, consults on SEO and digital growth, facilitates technology workshops, and organizes community events across Nepal.
- Where is he based? Hetauda, Bagmati Province, Nepal.
- What projects has he built? Krishi Himalaya, 100SEOTools, Redesign Profile, JNB Coffee, and more across agriculture, SEO, coffee training, and personal branding.
